$description: Rhythm/position rules that JSON Schema cannot express. Each id here is implemented in schema/semantic_validate.py (IMPLEMENTED_GRAPH_RULES); verify_all.py fails if the two sets diverge. Every rule was checked against templates/templates.json at the time it was written.

rules.rule: Exactly one HERO-category node per page.
rules.exceptions: none: template.loop-landing has exactly one hero (hero.ticket). shell.mobile-brand-intro is SHELL, not a second hero.

rules.rule: The hero node precedes every in-flow-loop node.
The first in-flow-loop node is layout.scroll-runway variant hero and the last is variant tail; each variant appears once.
cta.closing-band is the last non-spacer in-flow-loop node (it carries the footer).
Every navItems target names a section that is present on the page.
shell.mobile-menu navItems equal shell.sidebar-nav navItems (same labels, same targets, same order): both render the same nav list.
shell.mobile-brand-intro tagline equals shell.sidebar-nav tagline (both render the same tagline constant).
Adjacent in-flow-loop nodes have different semantic categories.
rules.exceptions: none observed in the source order

rules.rule: Patterns bound to global loop progress or the pointer (hero-ticket-flight, fish-wheel-scrub, bot-cursors, cursor-trail, oval-breathe, overlay-slide) appear at most once per page.
Each review's paragraphs total <= 399 characters (the measured 8-line maximum inside the ellipse).

evidence.expect: - Review 2: 1 paragraph of **399 chars** (8 lines at 1440).

rules.rule: initiallyOpenIndex, when given, points at an existing item (source opens item 1 on load).
